what: An INDEPENDENT autonomous operator caught a malicious solver on-chain, with no human: watched a reveal, fetched the solution by CID, re-ran the exact verifier, found it invalid/inflated, and filed a bonded challenge. The resolver upheld it, the submission was Rejected, and the operator ended NET-POSITIVE — proving the M2 audit fix (policing fraud is profitable) live.
attack: malicious solver submitted problems/hadamard-mini/examples/lying-claim.json (all-++++, true improvement 0/1) while CLAIMING improvement 1/1

outcome.operator_net_eth: +0.0004 (own challenge bond returned + forfeited solver bond, minus gas)

honest_caveats: DA is a LOCAL store (agent/da-local.mjs) — the operator fetches the blob by CID and re-derives the verdict independently, but this is a placeholder for a real Arweave/DA provider.

The operator (key B) is genuinely independent, but solver+sponsor+resolver are one EOA (key A) — full role separation is Phase 2, and one-stack-plays-all-sides is the wash-trading concern in docs/AUTONOMY.md.
Resolution is still a TRUSTED key (Phase 3 wall) — the operator proves detection+challenge, not trustless adjudication.
